Review all nine regions for stable crater rims or other identifiable shapes. Each row shows the same nominal footprint. Zoom in to compare shape under opposite synthetic lighting. Nearest-neighbour enlargement preserves the inspection pixels.

Green quality pixels indicate successful stereo matching; blue indicates shadow and amber interpolation. Complete-cell support percentages use the numeric area fractions, not the display colour. Clear stereo support alone does not prove a photo-to-terrain correspondence. Zero pairs are accepted.

For a candidate, record a precise feature definition, image and mission coordinates, picking uncertainty and competing interpretations. Reserve checks before fitting; obtain repeated picks before assessing a correction. Use the source hashes and region bounds in the companion JSON.
